name: playtest_peaks
description: Not a test — the install step for a hands-on session aimed at the convective-top look: bright fluffy peaks over a dark self-shadowed body, §25c's raymarch on, run with --hold. THREE THINGS THIS FIXES ABOUT THE PREVIOUS SESSION, all of which made it show nothing. (1) It was shot at -2.44 degrees, BELOW the horizon, where the light ray descends through the cloud and essentially everything is shadowed by definition — the lit-peaks read needs a low but POSITIVE sun, so this uses late afternoon. (2) §25's sheets are large and few, so the shipped mid-range cloud fraction put two of them on a 250-cell map and the camera was looking at neither: cloud_cover_forced_overcast fills the sky instead, and cloud_sheets_in_view is pinned so a cloudless frame fails loudly rather than handing over an empty one. (3) The volume was a pancake — 22 texels tall on a 128-texel blob — with no vertical relief for anything to shadow; CloudRaymarchMath.MaxHeightFraction now stands a cloud about as tall as it is broad. Run with --no-profiler and Circinus alone: Dubs instruments every Harmony patch in the load, which distorts what Circinus measures.
